rule_compliance_audit.description: Review rules vs current Sudoku scope and docs. Ensure .cursor/rules/*.mdc matches docs/sudoku-*.md and the repo’s actual tech stack.

dependency_updates_review.description: Review and update dependencies (Expo, React Native, Supabase, testing toolchain)

code_quality_review.description: Review code quality metrics and improvements (lint, types, test stability)

security_audit.description: Security audit and vulnerability check (npm audit, Supabase policies review)

performance_review.description: Performance review and optimization check (grid input latency, generation time, startup)

schema_documentation_sync.description: Sync schema documentation with migrations (SQLite + Supabase). Ensure new tables/columns are documented with intent and constraints.

supabase_migrations_review.description: Review Supabase schema/migrations and RLS policies for correctness and security

e2e_flake_review.description: Review E2E flakiness and stabilize Playwright/Maestro tests

eas_build_profiles_review.description: Review EAS build profiles and environment variable usage to ensure secrets are not embedded into the client bundle.

privacy_controls_review.description: Review privacy controls (analytics opt-out, export/delete account, clear local data) against PRD and ensure implementations remain compliant.
